newsitem.title: USA: Drop in large cap techs pressure Nasdaq.
newsitem.headline: Drop in large cap techs pressure Nasdaq.

text.p: Nasdaq shares cooled Tuesday as several large capitalization technology stocks took a beating, traders said.

Nasdaq shares dropped 10.60 points or 0.79 percent to 1333.59. The drop in the Nasdaq outpaced a slight drop in the Dow Industrials, which lost 18.54 points or 0.25 percent to close unofficially at 7274.21.

"Tech stocks have had a good run lately, so today there was some fall off after folks like Intel set the tone for the day. When the heavy-weights take a breather, the rest become more cautious too," one trader said.

Intel Corp, the most active Nasdaq issue, dropped 6-3/4 to 152-3/8 after Digital Equipment Corp filed a patent infringement suit against Intel. Other technology issues such as Dell Computer Corp and Micron Electronics Inc also lost ground.
Andrew Corp, which dropped nearly 20 percent after two analysts downgraded the stock, citing concerns about the company's revenue stream.
Declining issues beat gaining issues 2170 to 2046 on total volume of 605 million. Nasdaq shares have lost ground in only three of past 10 sessions.
